note: Both sets correctly capture the near-linear dependence of pitch sensitivity on blade-pitch angle in Region 3 and the rated mechanical power of 5.296610 MW with supporting quotes. Set A, however, repeats the rated-power claim a second time without its 'rated' condition, adding no information. Set B states the same two facts without duplication, so it is the cleaner and slightly better set. Both sets omit several notable facts on the page (rated rotor speed 12.1 rpm, the Table 7-1 sensitivity data, and the conclusion that constant PI gains are not adequate).
remarks: Both extractions ignore the page's main quantitative content: Table 7-1 (sensitivity of aerodynamic power to blade pitch, ∂P/∂θ from -28.24E+6 to -125.30E+6 watt/rad over 11.4-25.0 m/s) and the rated rotor speed Ω0 = 12.1 rpm. The engineering conclusion that constant PI gains are not adequate for effective speed control is also missed by both. Set A's second rated-power claim is a verbatim repeat of the first minus the 'rated' condition.
